notes.title: Journey Begins!
notes.content:
-
We proudly announce that [b] Ayo: A Rain Tale [/b] is now available on Steam!

This adventure platformer sheds light on the perils of water-fetching trips of women and children in sub-Saharan Africa. Join us as we #JourneyForWater

Facebook: www.facebook.com/ayothegame/
Twitter: twitter.com/ayothegame
